tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dngos grub nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren mchog bla na med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig 'dus pa/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mtshungs med brgyud pa'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i/ /smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang gis/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad pa/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang bdag rdo rje snying po'i sprul pa'i gar/ /ngur smrig bla gos 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs can/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /blo gter dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdod nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brnyes na yang / /bdag sogs dus mtha'i gdul bya'i don slad du/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /ngag dbang legs pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnam 'phrul chos kyi rje/ /ma lus shes bya kun mkhyen paṇḍi ta/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba'i sras/ /gzhan phan snang ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin chen po padma'i rgyal tshab mchog /snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar son grub pa'i rje/ /sna tshogs rang sar grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dpa' bo rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma nyams tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi nor gyis phyug /yun ring drin gyis skyong mdzad dge ba'i bshes/ /bstan 'dzin dbang grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i zhen pa ring du spangs/ /zab mo dbu ma'i de nyid thugs su chud/ /rlabs chen gzhan phan spyod pas dus 'da' ba/ /'jam dbyangs snyan grags zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /rnam mang rgyud sde'i bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin/

/smin grol gdams pa'i gter mdzod chos kyi rje/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa mkhyen brtse'i rje'i/ /gsang gsum ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ba/ /chos kyi blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na 'dren mchog ma ti'i mtshan can sogs/ /zab mo'i chos kyi bka' drin thob pa yi/ /bcu phrag gnyis kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa la/ /snying nas dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs chab kyi rkyen las zla gzugs bzhin/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis rnam 'gyur tha dad kyang / /ngo bo sangs rgyas nyid du gcig pa yi/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub brgyud pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ma nyams gang thugs rgya mtshor gnas bcas pa'i/ /'dren pa kun 'dus dpal mgon bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /ma lus rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag che/ /rab 'byams yi dam dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal mgon bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rang don chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ /gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'gro la ston/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal mgon bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i de nyid thugs su chud/ /zab rgyas chos phung rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas/ /lung rtogs yon tan dbang phyug bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon mongs dgra btul srid la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /gzhan phan sems 'byongs 'gro la bu ltar brtse/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bdud sde'i mun 'joms thub bstan padmo'i tshal/ /skyong mkhas phrin las rnam bzhi'i tsha zer can/

/dam can rgya mtsho'i ngo bo bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo med dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i nor bu'i gru char gyis/ /srid zhi'i phongs pa sel mdzad bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' khyab skyabs gnas rgya mtsho spro ba'i bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /brtan g.yo kun khyab 'khor lo'i mgon po la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bdud dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /btsal na rang las gzhan du mi rnyed pas/ /sems snang 'khrul pa'i 'jigs pa 'di mthong nas/ /rje btsun bla ma 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs/ /kun rtog nyon mongs rags shing dran shes med/ /rang skyon spong bar 'dod kyang gnyen po chung / /las ngan rang gi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ /rje btsun bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bla ma mchog las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /rtag tu mi brjed dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon chad rang gis nyes pa spyad pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las snod du ma gyur pa'i/ /las ngan bdag gi blo sna bstung nas ni/ /sgo gsum chos la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon gyi las dang rkyen las byung ba yi/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i gnod pa sogs/ /lus srog dge la bar du gcod pa yi/ /nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lung rtogs yon tan rgyud la skye ba'i gegs/ /gnas grogs longs spyod ngan pa'i rkyen dbang sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud las ma lus pa/ /da lta nyid du zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lus sems zug rngu'i rgyu ru gyur pa yi/ /gnas gos zas dang gnod byed gdon bgegs dang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i grib ma la sogs pas/ /nam yang gos pa med par byin gyis rlobs/

/'khrul snang sdug bsngal kun gyis mi brdzi ba'i/ /'jigs med dgongs pa'i btsan sa ma zin bar/ /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa kun bsal nas/ /tshe srog ring du 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rmongs pas bslus pas nyon mongs yan par shor/ /bag med dbang gis sgo gsum ma bsdams pas/ /thog med dus nas bdag gis bsags pa yi/ /las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi med bdag tu bzung ba'i ma rig las/ /gnyis 'dzin chags sdang 'khrul pa'i blo byung ba/ /mi zad srid pa'i phung khrol kun gyi rgyu/ /nyon mongs rang mtshang rig par byin gyis rlobs/ /med snang smig rgyu'i chu bo'i rjes bsnyegs pa'i/ /kun rtog 'khrul pa'i ngal khur mi len par/ /'grub med bsam pa'i mtha' rgya bskyungs nas ni/ /sems nyid las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'dzem med mu cor smra ba'i ngang tshul 'di/ /rnam g.yengs nyon mongs bskyed pa'i rgyur shes nas/ /rang dang gzhan la phan nges ma gtogs pa'i/ /'bras med smra brjod nyung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bag med lang la shor ba'i sgo gsum po/ /rgyun du yang dag lam la bskul byed pa'i/ /dran shes bzang po'i sems kyi srung ma dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen ngan bdud kyis khyer ram g.yeng bas bslus/ /chos min rtog pa skyes tshe de ma thag /bla ma'i snang ba shar nas bdag gi blo/ /yang dag lam la gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dod yon sgyu ma'i nor la mi chags shing / /chog shes 'phags pa'i 'byor ba dang ldan pas/ /thub pa dgyes pa'i spyod pa la gnas te/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba spong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin mgu dka' byas la drin mi gzo/ /brten na bslu ba srin mo'i ngang tshul can/ /blo gtad med pa'i snyigs ma'i grogs spangs nas/ /bse ru'i rnam thar 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan dbang 'du 'dzi'i 'ching ba las thar nas/

/chags dang sdang ba'i gtam yang mi thos shing / /rang bzhin nyams dga' rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ /dben pa'i ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi dang nang gi dge ba'i bshes kyis zin/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i zas gos yo byad dang / /dge legs yon tan skyed pa'i gnas grogs sogs/ /mthun rkyen 'bad med rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyid 'dod tshe 'dir zhen pa'i blo ngan dang / /ltar snang gzhan don sgrub pa'i rnam g.yengs sogs/ /chos brgyad lam kha'i ro bzhin spangs nas ni/ /sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs gsum ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma la/ /sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /khyed shes blo gtad nam yang mi 'gyur bas/ /snying nas skyabs su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rmongs pa'i blo la rab dga' skyed byed pa'i/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs gshed ma ltar mthong nas/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin 'khor ba'i grong khyer la/ /zhen pa gting nas log par byin gyis rlobs/ /srid mtsho sgrol byed dal 'byor lus kyi gru/ /mi rtag g.yo ba'i rang bzhin de shes nas/ /skad cig tsam yang dal bar mi sdod par/ /sgrub la snying rus nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /stong pa'i dbyings su spros pa kun zhi yang / /snang ba rten 'byung bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ /kun rdzob dge sdig rgyu 'bras chos rnams la/ /blang dor tshul bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /tsha grang bkres skom skyo 'jigs la sogs pa/ /lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal gang byung kun/ /las ngan sgrib sbyong rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du/ /rkyen ngan lam slong nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /phul byung snying stobs mchog gi go bgos nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i khur chen 'khyer ba la/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i bdud sde dgrar langs kyang / /mi ldog brtson 'grus brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun rang gi pha mar mthong nas ni/

/tshad med byams dang snying rjes rgyud bskul te/ /gzhan gyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog /thob 'dod lhag bsam skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phrag dog 'gran sems nga rgyal kun gyi rgyu/ /rang nyid gces 'dzin 'gong po btul nas ni/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems mchog legs goms pas/ /rang don yid byed zad par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus srog longs spyod gang la'ang mi chags par/ /thams cad sgrol dang byams pa'i stobs bzhin du/ /nyams thag ma rgan 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtag tu phan bde sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dka'i lus rten sbyin pa'i pha ma dang / /brtse gdung byams pas skyong ba'i gnyen bshes sogs/ /'jigs rung srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /myur du bdag gis skyob par byin gyis rlobs/ /phangs pa'i srog la rgol ba'i dgra bo yang / /byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su mthong nas ni/ /de yi rkyen gyis 'khrugs par mi 'gyur bar/ /dge tshogs lhag par 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rmongs pas bslus pa byis pa'i skye bo yis/ /nyon mongs dbang gis log sgrub byed na yang / /smyo ba'i bu la byams pa'i ma bzhin du/ /slar yang brtse bas skyong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag la brten nas gzhan gyi sems rgyud la/ /mi dge'i rtog pa nam yang mi skye zhing / /mthong thos tsam gyis 'brel ba tshun chod kyang / /blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnod pa'i bsam sbyor rab tu goms pa yi/ /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa'i 'gro ba yang / /bdag nyid mthong thos dran pa'i skad cig la/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na gang du su dang 'grogs kyang rung / /chags sdang nyon mongs nam yang mi 'phel zhing / /'phral dang yun gyi phan bde'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /rnam dkar dge ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bcas mtshams ma nor bar/

/'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas shing / /rmi lam na yang nyams pa'i dri ma yis/ /nam yang gos pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi dang nang gi dben pa la brten nas/ /gcig tu zhi ba'i yid la mnyam bzhag pas/ /g.yeng ba'i rkyen gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i/ /g.yo med ting 'dzin brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa'i/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i blo gros thob nas ni/ /zang zing med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa yis/ /bstan la bya ba byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /ris med brtse ba'i gsal snang ma 'gags pa'i/ /chos kyi snying po don dam byang chub sems/ /tshul bzhin rgyud la 'byor par byin gyis rlobs/ /chags pa bdun spangs khyad chos bzhi ldan pa'i/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i nyams len phar phyin drug /chos spyod gcig la'ang tshang bar sgrub nus pa'i/ /blo yi nus pa rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyod pa rmad byung bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma thul ba'i/ /shin tu gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la/ /chos kyi snang ba skyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshig don mtha' dag mi brjed gzungs kyi sgo/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs med spobs pa'i gter/ /ngo mtshar yon tan 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin/ /ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs shes zung 'jug smon pa'i mthu chen gyis/ /skad cig rer yang bskal pa'i tshogs 'dum zhing / /lhan cig rdzogs smin sbyang ba mthar phyin pa'i/ /kun bzang rnam thar skyong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs rgyu yi rten 'brel las byung ba'i/ /bzang ngan nyams kyi snang ba ma lus pa/ /zhen med rtsis gdab spangs pa'i lam khyer gyis/ /gang yang grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang gsum yon tan gter gyis rab gang ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/

/zhum med spro ba'i yid kyis zhugs nas ni/ /'phrin las ro gcig 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon mchog /rtse gcig dad pas tshul bzhin legs brten nas/ /ma nor brgyud pa'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i/ /rnam dag dbang gis smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang las skyes pa'i nyams myong ye shes mchog /mi nyams spel ba'i thabs tshul bzhi ldan gyis/ /mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bza' srung mi 'bral ba'i/ /dam tshig srog bzhin srung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi nang don gyi sngags kyi ngo bo shes/ /spro bsdu la sogs man ngag gnad kyis zin/ /ngag yid rlung gi lam la brten pa yi/ /bzlas brjod mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos grub 'gugs pa'i yo byad dam rdzas tshang / /sbyang rtogs sbar ba'i dmigs pa rang byan tshud/ /'khor gsum yongs dag gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mkha' 'gro dam can mnyes par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdang mig tsam gyis bdud tshogs mthar byed pa'i/ /myur mgyogs 'phrin las dbang phyug srung ma'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /mi 'bral rgyun du 'grogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pa yis/ /ye shes me lha mnyes pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /grub gnyis rin chen gter gyi sgo phyes nas/ /sgrub 'bras myur du 'byin par byin gyis rlobs/ /shin tu gsang bar 'os pa yi/ /tshigs bcad drug po 'di ru 'jug /dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma lha ru mthong / /byin rlabs rtsa ba mos gus lam du longs/ /chos kun rtsa ba sems kyi de nyid rig /lam gyi srog rtsa zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /snod bcud 'khor 'das snang ba ma lus pa/ /nang gi rten 'brel nyid las byung ba'i tshul/ /rtogs nas sna tshogs phyi yi spros pa yi/ /sgro 'dogs nang nas chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /blo ngan rtog ges sgro skur ma yin par/

/nang gi de nyid rtogs pa'i nyams myong gis/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don 'chad nus pa'i/ /sbas don snying la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshig la brten nas rnam mang chos tshul gyi/ /pha mtha' tshol ba'i ngal ba mi dgos par/ /bde blag nyid du kun mkhyen sgrub pa yi/ /rten 'brel nang du 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba'i khams dbang mos pa bzhin/ /bgrang yas chos tshul rgya mtsho spro mkhas shing / /kun kyang rgyal ba'i lam du sdud bzod pa'i/ /bde gshegs chos mdzod lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /rten 'brel lnga ldan gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos/ /tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la legs phab nas/ /snyan brgyud bzhi yi rten 'brel rang rgyud la/ /tshul bzhin myur du 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bogs 'byin gdams pa'i bdud rtsi rkyen dang 'tshams/ /gegs sel srung ba'i man ngag dus dang 'byor/ /'dus pa gsum gyi lam 'phrang tshul bzhin brgal/ /drod rtags yon tan skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung sems yi ge'i khrid tshul rgyud la 'byor/ /las 'phro mos gus brtson pas byang sems bskul/ /gsal stong zung 'jug nyams kyi snang ba 'bar/ /lam mchog myur du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub phyogs mthun chos/ /lus dang sems kyi steng du bgrod pa'i tshul/ /rtogs nas rgyu 'bras theg pa'i brjod bya'i gnad/ /mi 'gal gcig tu mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu lam dbang gi ye shes chu bo'i rgyun/ /ma nub thun bzhi'i 'jug ngogs la brten nas/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho ru/ /gegs med myur du snyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyud gsum lhan skyes dbye ba ma lus pa/ /lhun grub sems kyi chos nyid 'di nyid las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i tshul shes nas/ /ma rig 'khrul pa sangs par byin gyis rlobs/ /cir yang snang ba rang sems gsal ba'i gdangs/

/gang du'ang ma grub sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can/ /rten 'byung snang ba spros pas ma bslad par/ /brjod bral rang zhal mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /kun nyon rgyu 'bras ma spangs lam du khyer/ /sku dang ye shes ma bsgrubs lhun gyis grub/ /re dogs dgag sgrub spros pa dbyings su zhi/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyon nyid yon tan mchog gi rgyur mthong zhing / /bar chad bdud las dngos grub len nus pa'i/ /cir snang dge ba'i bshes su 'char ba yi/ /'jigs med gdeng drod rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam mang rtog pa'i rba rlabs cher g.yo bas/ /bde chen sems kyi gnas cha mi bsgribs shing / /kun rtog nyon mongs 'khrugs pas ye shes kyi/ /gsal snang mchog tu 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul ngor snang ba'i srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /'khrul par shes na bde chen ye shes te/ /snang srid bde bar rol pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sdug bsngal dbyings su sangs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bying rgod nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa dang / /skyon med zung 'jug nyams kyi ting 'dzin gnyis/ /bzang ngan med par lam du bsrel nus pa'i/ /gdams pa nyams su lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /spangs thob dbyer med rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu/ /yang dag shes nas gnyis 'dzin re dogs kyi/ /rtog pa'i drwa ba nam yang mi spel bar/ /'bras bu'i mchog 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi snang skye gnas 'chi ba bar do bzhi/ /rim dang cig char sbyong ba'i lam khyer gyis/ /myur du sku bzhi'i ngo bor dag byed pa'i/ /bskyed rim lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs/ /gdos bcas gzugs kyi snang ba lha ru mthong / /grags pa sgra yi rang gdangs sngags su shes/ /dran rtog yid kyi 'gyu ba chos skur dag /rdo rje gsum mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems lha brgya'i ngo bo rdo rje sems/

/kun khyab rigs kyi bdag por mthong ba'i mod/ /yi dam rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mchog /dus gcig nyid la mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zab mo'i lam gyis lus la gnad du bsnun/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis rtogs pa sems la shar/ /snang sems ro gcig ye shes mngon du gyur/ /rdzogs rim pha mthar son par byin gyis rlobs/ /da lta'i rang gi snang ba 'di nyid las/ /lam dang 'bras bu logs nas mi tshol bar/ /rgyu 'bras rgyas gdab man ngag la brten nas/ /spros pa'i drwa ba mchod par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan rtog 'chal ba'i dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /bde chen ye shes sdom pa'i ngo bo ru/ /smin grol lam gyi zab gnad kun dril nas/ /dus gcig nyams su lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das bsre ba'i gsang gnad la brten nas/ /rjes spyod lam gyi yan lag gcig la yang / /gzhi lam 'bras gsum tshang ba'i lam khyer gyis/ /grub gnyis mgron du khugs par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba ma lus pa/ /zag med bde ba'i nye rgyur mthong nas ni/ /gang shar bde stong rol pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'dod yon rgyan du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gtsang sme gnyis rtog 'joms pa'i dam rdzas la/ /mnyam nyid brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rol pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i thabs kyi dga' ston gyis/ /bde stong ye shes 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam nying 'khrul snang ba rang ngo zin/ /sprul bsgyur brtan pa thob pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rgyal ba kun las dam chos nyan pa dang / /nyams rtogs bogs 'don byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyin snang 'khrul pa sgyu ma'i rol par shes/ /mtshan snang ma rig 'od gsal dbyings su dengs/ /nyin mtshan bar med sgrib bral ye shes kyi/ /snang ba 'gags pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na 'khrul snang blo yi ri mo kun/ /spros bral 'od gsal don dam chos kyi sku/

/mngon sum mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes su/ /rtsol med ngang gis 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mthar 'dzin rtog pa'i rdul gyis ma bslad cing / /gzung 'dzin snang ba'i sprin gyis ma bsgribs par/ /lhan skyes bde chen rig stong gnyug ma'i gshis/ /rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba dbang du 'dus/ /mnyen lcug bzhi yi yon tan lus la shar/ /skye mched drug tu dwangs ma'i nus pa 'phel/ /ting 'dzin mthu chen rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /tha dad gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul bkod pa'i las la dbang / /zhi sogs dngos grub bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /'gro ba'i phan bde spel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi nang rten 'brel mthun pa'i spyod mchog gis/ /so gnyis yul gyi mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus/ /sum phrag bcu gnyis rtags kyi yon tan rnams/ /ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gros bzhi dbyings su bsdu ba'i rgyal thabs kyis/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i g.yul ngo rab bcom nas/ /che ba gsum ldan chos sku'i rgyal srid la/ /dbang bskur tshe 'dir thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rten 'brel mthar thug sku lnga'i pad tshal du/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi bung ba'i tshogs 'du zhing / /lhun grub 'phrin las sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud kyis/ /skal ldan gdul bya tshim par byin gyis rlobs/ /thog mar lta sgom spyod la rim gyis zhugs/ /bar du gsum po gnad thog gcig tu dril/ /tha mar bsam brjod bral ba'i ye shes su/ /thams cad ro mnyam rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bgrang yas mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i don/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /lam dus thun bzhi'i nyams len la brten nas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tha mal snang zhen skyabs kyi ngo bor dag

/bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byang chub lam du bsgyur/ /sdig ltung ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ /rang rgyud shin tu dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang las nyon rnam dag tshogs su bsgyur/ /bdud rigs bar chad srung ba'i 'khor lor shar/ /tha mal snod bcud rten dang brten pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha ru 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lus la sku bzhi lhun gyis grub par rtogs/ /sems las logs na ye shes med par rig /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par mthong / /zung 'jug ting 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phung po sangs rgyas nyon mongs ye shes dang / /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo ru/ /shes nas goms pas rgyu 'bras lhun grub kyi/ /sangs rgyas rang las rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa yig rlung sems rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /smin grol thabs kyi mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /rang byung gnyis med ye shes don gyi lha'i/ /rang zhal myur du mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ye shes kyis/ /rjes thob snang ba'i chos la rgyas 'debs shing / /chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /mtshan rtog 'khrul 'khor 'jig par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid dag pa lha yi 'khor lor rdzogs/ /rtsa thig rlung gi dwangs ma chos skur smin/ /'khor 'das ye shes gcig gi ngo bor zlum/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku drin mtshungs med yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas yid ches bcos ma ma yin pa'i/ /mos gus rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum longs spyod dge tshogs rgyur byas pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid bcas pa yi/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul lta bu'i mchod sprin gyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchod par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma mchog

/nyin mo spyi bor mtshan mo snying dbus su/ /rtag tu bsgoms shing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /shin tu gsang ba nang gi rten 'brel las/ /sku bzhi'i bla ma 'byung ba'i tshul shes nas/ /nang gi bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /byin rlabs sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs mchog /don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal mjal ba'i mod/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig nas ni/ /'khor ba'i rdzun ris dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor mthong / /dge sbyor thams cad bla ma'i lam du shar/ /'khor 'das thams cad bla ma'i rol par shes/ /snang srid bla mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal mgon bla ma las/ /byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i dngos grub legs thob nas/ /da lta'i 'dug sa stan thog 'di nyid du/ /dgongs pa dbyer med 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu rigs thabs kyi rim pas legs sbyangs nas/ /'bad pas 'bras bu sgrub la mi ltos par/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i skad cig la/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo dus gcig nyid la thob/ /lam bzhi'i ngo bo rig thog gcig tu rdzogs/ /sku bzhi gnyis med rang rig bde ba che'i/ /ye shes gcig tu mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dri med sems kyi chos nyid byang chub sems/ /blo dang tshig gis ma bcos gdod ma'i gshis/ /stong gsal phyogs ris bral ba'i bla ma las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can sangs rgyas dgongs pa gcig tu mthong / /lam dang 'bras bu'i tha snyad dbyings su nub/ /gnyis chos thams cad gnyis med klong du dag /kun kyang tshul gcig rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub gnas 'gyur 'gal med don rtogs nas/ /gzhi 'bras dbyer med skyon yon ro mnyam pa'i/

/zung 'jug bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /lus rten 'di la thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde chen dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rol pa bsam yas kyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'khor ba ma stong de srid du/ /bla ma'i 'phrin las skyong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /skyid sdug legs nyes snang ba ci shar yang / /dpal mgon bla ma dran pa'i mos gus dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo med don yod rnam bzhi'i spyod pa yis/ /'khor lo'i mgon po legs par mnyes byas nas/ /myur du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon smin grol thabs kyis sbyangs/ /lta ba'i nyams myong grub mtha'i ngo bor shar/ /nye rgyu la brten 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung thob/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa na/ /lus dang sems la sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /zab lam rtogs pa'i gdeng drod dang ldan pas/ /mi 'jigs rab dga' rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /de tshe drin chen bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pas/ /yid 'phrog mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bsus te/ /dag pa'i zhing du khrid par byin gyis rlobs/ /der ni tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i 'od lus grub nas ni/ /rten des sa lam lhag ma kun bgrod de/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bdag gis thob nas ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i 'gro khams la/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter gyi sgo phyes nas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma 'ongs slad ma'i skye ba thams cad du/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nyon mongs chung ba dang / /mchog la gus shing dman la shin tu byams/

/rtag tu tshe rabs dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /der yang bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing / /bstan la rab byung tshul khrims rnam par dag /lung dang rtogs pa'i chos kyi mdzod bzung nas/ /'gro ba'i mgon skyabs byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /bla ma mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las skyong ba la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo med snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i don/ /bslu med rten 'brel zab mo'i bden pa dang / /mtshungs med drin chen bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /gegs med myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /slar smras pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /shes rab bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi chab/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog gi bzhed pa'i gzhung / /'phags bod grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog rnams kyi/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i zab pa'i chos/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len kun tshang ba/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag las 'ongs pa'i/ /dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje'i lam gyi srol/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs zab mo'i chos 'di la/ /lam gyi khrid tshul mang du bzhugs pa las/ /zab 'bring tha gsum lam gyi rim pa yi/ /nyams len snying po phal cher bsdus nas ni/ /tshul bzhin rang gi rgyud la 'byor ba'i phyir/ /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rje bskul ba'i ngag /dngos grub nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta 'di/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ /mi med lung stong nyul ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /blun po rang gi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ /rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs phyir bris/ /skyes dang sbyangs pa'i blo gros shin tu dman/ /zab mo'i lam la 'dris goms ma bgyis shing / /las ngan khur gyis non pa'i byis pa bdag /zab don 'chad la dbang ba ma yin pas/

/bdag blo 'khrul pa'i dri mas sbags pa dang / /sbas don gsal bar bshad pa la sogs pa/ /gal te 'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /rje btsun mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /zab mo'i lam 'di'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i/ /brgyud 'dzin dam pa gong mas mdzad pa yi/ /khrid gzhung rnams su gsal bar ma gsungs pa/ /'ga' zhig 'di na yod mod rang bzo min/ /dang po'i las can rim gyis bkri tshul dang / /gdams pa yongs rdzogs thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul gyi/ /rnam dbye legs par khong du chud pa dang / /dbang bzhi'i lam gyis so sor bkri ba dang / /lam bzhi'i rnal 'byor rim bzhin bsgom pa dang / /gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa sogs/ /lam gyi 'jug ldog tshul la ma rmongs shing / /'khor 'das thun mong chos bdun so so dang / /gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len tshul la/ /rmongs pa med pa'i blo gros thob pa na/ /zab mo'i don la yid ches skye bar 'gyur/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brtse chen yab sras brgyud par bcas pa la/ /sgo gsum gus pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ /legs gsung mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshig tsam thos na'ang 'chi med mchog sbyin pa'i/ /de yi gsung rab la yang gus phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad kyi/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i snying po yongs bsdus nas/ /phyi rabs gdul bya'i skal par bzhag pa yi/ /gong ma'i gsung rab ston pa'i rgyal tshab yin/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdud rtsi'i chu gter las/ /sngon byon grub pa'i ded dpon gyis blangs pa'i/ /'dod 'byung gzhung bzang yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /sa skya'i rjes 'jug yongs kyi spyi nor lags/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phongs pa kun sel ba'i/

/gsang chen gdams pa'i gter 'di rnyed nas ni/ /spyod dang gzhan la sbyin par mi byed par/ /da dung slong mor rgyu na smyo'am ci/ /rtog ge'i blo yis 'ol tshod ma yin par/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la 'bebs nus pa'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di 'dra 'jig rten dag na dkon/ /sde snod gsum gyi zab don 'di na bzhugs/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi nyams len 'di la tshang / /man ngag kun gyi gter kha 'di na yod/ /gzhung bzang 'di ni rgyal ba'i chos mdzod yin/ /yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs kyi rnam grangs mang / /spros pa gcod pa'i shes rab ral gri rno/ /zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i rim pa zab/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang 'di 'dra med/ /rtag ltas ma gos bden med sgyu mar ston/ /chad lta ma yin rten 'brel lam du byed/ /rtog ges ma bslad mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 'di/ /'dor bar byed na sems yod ji ltar yin/ /lta ba yangs pas gang la'ang zhen pa gcod/ /spyod pa zhib pas blang dor tshul bzhin ston/ /thabs la mkhas pas lta spyod zung du 'jug /lam bzang 'di shes sangs rgyas mi ring nye/ /thun tshags ma yin mdo rgyud kun gyi bcud/ /rang bzos ma bslad 'khrul med brgyud pa'i srol/ /byin rlabs ma nyams snyan brgyud bzhi ldan pa'i/ /lam 'di mkhas grub bye ba'i gshegs shul yin/ /smin byed dbang gi cho ga ma 'khrugs shing / /grol byed lam gyi rim pa zab cing rgyas/ /bogs 'byin lam gyi yan lag kun tshang ba'i/ /chos 'di rig 'dzin yongs kyi thugs dam yin/ /rang gi nyams len phyogs su ma lhung zhing / /gzhan gyi chos la sgro skur mi dgos par/ /dag snang ngang nas dge sbyor 'phel ba zhig /gzhung 'dir thos bsam byas pa'i lag rjes yin/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gzhung lugs thams cad gdams pa 'char ba zhig /nyams myong tshad mas gtan la 'bebs 'dod na/

/zab mo'i don 'di sgom pas nyams su longs/ /yid 'ongs sa 'dzin mthon po'i rtse mo nas/ /dma' ba'i ljongs su ltad mo lta ba bzhin/ /grub mtha' kun gyi gnad gsang dus gcig tu/ /mthong ba 'di yang lam 'di'i che ba lags/ /gang zhig mthong na srid pa'i mun 'joms pa/ /thub pa'i chos tshul rten 'byung zab mo'i don/ /bstan pa 'di las phyi rol ma gyur pa'i/ /grub mtha' 'dzin pa kun la grags na yang / /shin tu gsang ba nang gi rten 'brel gyi/ /zab mo'i don ni man ngag 'di nyid las/ /bka' srol gzhan gyis gsal bar ma mdzad pas/ /lugs 'di gzhan las khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs/ /rgyu las 'bras bu logs nas mi tshol zhing / /gzhi 'bras dbyer med rtogs pa'i nye lam gyis/ /rang bzhin lhun grub sku bzhi ngo sprod pa'i/ /zab mo'i lam 'di mtshan don mthun pa lags/ /tha snyad tshig gi lam la ma brten par/ /zab mo nang gi rten 'brel bsgom pa'i mthus/ /ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa'i/ /shes rab klong rdol lam 'di'i khyad chos yin/ /grangs med bskal pa'i yun la mi ltos par/ /tshe gcig nyid la gdos bcas sgyu ma'i lus/ /'ja' lus dwangs ma'i sku ru sgyur byed pa'i/ /gdams ngag 'di ni gser 'gyur rtsi dang 'dra/ /gdul bya'i blo dang skal pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /thabs mkhas lam gyi bkri tshul mang ba'i phyir/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kun ster ba'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /gzhan ngor skyon dang bar chad ltar snang yang / /rang snang bde ba chen po'i ye shes su/ /mthong nas 'khrul snang gang gis mi rdzi ba'i/ /rkyen ngan lam slong gdams pa 'di 'dra med/ /skyid na gong non 'dod yon lam du byed/ /sdug na skyo grogs gang snang grogs su 'char/ /nyams len gegs sel gdams ngag bogs 'don pa'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /'di don shes na kun la dag snang skye/

/tshul bzhin bsgoms na snang ba lha ru 'char/ /mngon sum rtogs na sangs rgyas dngos yin pas/ /lam bzang 'di 'dra mjal rnams skal pa bzang / /las 'phro bzang zhing mos gus mchog ldan pa/ /sna tshogs lam gyi spros pa ma brten kyang / /skad cig nyid la sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /dbang po rab kyi chos kyang 'di nas gsungs/ /dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes ma nyams par/ /man ngag tshul bzhi'i srung ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /mi ring myur du sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /dbang po 'bring gi nyams len 'di na bzhugs/ /rnam lnga'i rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs nas ni/ /'bad rtsol drag pos rgyun du goms byas pas/ /ye shes skyes nas grol bar 'gyur ba yi/ /dbang po tha ma'i chos kyang 'di nas gsungs/ /gzhan yang blo dang skal pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /thabs shes phyogs su zhen pas dbye ba yi/ /dbang po rab 'bring drug gi bkri tshul sogs/ /lam gyi khrid tshul nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhugs/ /de slad gang dag gzhung 'dir dad na yang / /lam 'di ha cang spros pa rgya che bas/ /'di 'dra nyams su len par mi nus zhes/ /sngangs skrag skye ba thugs rgyus chung ba'i rtags/ /brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi man ngag sogs/ /rang gi nyams len gang la brtson kyang rung / /lam gyi spyi gzhung 'di 'dras zin pa dgos/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin zhing / /gsang 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 'di lags mod/ /'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus kyi shugs brtas pas/ /bstan pa'i snang byed 'di ni nub la nye/ /theg gsum lam gyi rtogs rigs ma lus pa/ /mchog gsang snying po'i thabs mkhas la brten nas/ /rig thog gcig la nyams su len nus pa'i/ /lam 'di kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i myur lam yin/ /'di 'dra mngon sum rtogs na smos ci dgos/ /go yul tsam du nyams su myong bas kyang / /srid pa'i snang shes hrul por bgyid nus na/

/'di la mi spro blo ldan su zhig yod/ /'gal 'du sdeb pa rtog ge'i blo gros kyis/ /zab mo'i don 'di rtogs par mi nus pas/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin byin rlabs brgyud pa'i srol/ /mos gus kho nas nyams su len par rigs/ /mkhas grub bla ma'i nyin byed dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /dri med gsung gi 'od snang 'bum g.yo ba/ /blo gros padmo'i gnyen du 'thung shes na/ /zab don rtogs pa'i pad tshal bzhad par nges/ /rten 'brel 'di 'dra phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /blo gros lus sgrim mang thos ral pas brjid/ /skal bzang sdom brtson mi yi seng ge dag /snyan brgyud gangs ri 'dzin pa'i dus la babs/ /dri med ring lugs chos kyi snang ba 'di/ /chos kyi dbang phyug bla ma'i 'dun sa ru/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin khyab par brdal na yang / /skal ngan 'ug pa'i tshogs kyis rnam par spangs/ /nges don gsung ngag yan lag brgyad pa'i chus/ /chos 'dod skom pas gdung ba'i rjes bsnyegs kyang / /smig rgyu'i chu bo tshol ba'i ngal ba yis/ /blo gsal 'ga' zhig dub par ma gyur tam/ /bla ma'i thugs zin gsung ngag gdams pa'i bcud/ /legs par myangs nas dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skal bzang de las skyid pa su zhig yod/ /dug lnga 'khrugs kyang ye shes skye ba'i rgyu/ /bdud dpung lhag kyang dngos grub stsol ba'i grogs/ /'khrul snang shar ba lha dang ye shes su/ /mthong ba de yang de la ring mi 'gyur/ /srid rtsa drung 'byin dge slong de yin te/ /'brel tshad don ldan rgyal ba'i sras po'ang de/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i chang la rtag rol pa'i/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i ded dpon dngos kyang de/ /mdor na lnga bdo snyigs ma'i dus su yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lag rtser gtod nus pa'i/ /bskal mang rnyed dka'i zab chos rin po che'i/ /yon tan mtha' dag su zhig brjod par nus/

/bstan pa'i bdag po bla chen phal mo ches/ /stobs 'byor mnga' thang sgrub pa'i rnam g.yeng gis/ /brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i/ /zab chos tshol la thugs las chung bar mdzad/ /bstan la gsar du zhugs pa'i blo gsal rnams/ /lto chos lag len sgrub pa'i ltad mo la/ /de dag gis kyang blo mig g.yengs nas ni/ /zab mo'i chos 'di sa 'og gter bzhin lus/ /sgrub brtson dam pa'i skyes bu phal cher yang / /bzlas grangs tsam la thugs rtse gtod pa las/ /zab chos 'di 'dra rang la yod pa yang / /gsan pa med na nyams su ji ltar bzhes/ /brgyud ldan bla ma tshul bzhin ma bsten pa'i/ /skyes sbyangs blo gros gsal ba'i mkhas pas kyang / /gzhung 'di bshad yam tsam du gzigs nas ni/ /snying po'i nyams len gzhan du tshol bar dgongs/ /kye ma 'jam mgon sa skya'i bstan pa ni/ /ltag chu zad pa'i rdzing bu'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /da ni shin tu nyams par mthong na yang / /snyigs ma'i rang mdangs bcos su ci zhig yod/ /bzlas grangs song bas mgrin pa skya ba dang / /za chog shes pas lto ba skya ba dang / /phyogs 'dzin byed pas kha skya tsam min par/ /snying nas sa skya'i bstan pa 'dzin bzhed na/ /yid ches rgyal ba'i bka' dang khyad med pa'i/ /'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung rab 'di dag la/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i sgo nas 'jug nus na/ /dal 'byor rin chen rnyed pa don bcas yin/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug gis/ /bkral ba'i bod kyi grub mtha' su la yang / /rab gus dad pas yid ches bskyed pa las/ /ma gus phyogs 'dzin bdag gi rgyud la med/ /'on kyang pha rgod bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos 'di'i rigs su skyes/ /me tog phog pa'i lha skal 'di nyid yin/ /brgyud pa bzang po'i pha chos 'di nyid yin/ /de slad brtson pas nyams su ma lon kyang / /zab pa'i yang rtse chos tshul 'di nyid la/ /yid ches bskyed nas mi med lung stong du/

/sprang po bdag ni 'chi ba bsgug snying 'dod/ /yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba'i/ /chos 'di bsgom pas nyams su ma lon kyang / /phas rgol 'bum gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i/ /yid ches dad pa snying gi dkyil na yod/ /chos 'di'i glegs bam sngas su bzhag nas ni/ /dpal mgon bla ma yid la dran bzhin du/ /mi rtag lnga pa'i lam du song na yang / /'gyod pa med do chos mthun grogs po dag /bla ma'i drin gyis las ngan bdag 'dra yang / /chos 'di'i rigs su skyes par khas 'che na/ /skal bzang blo gsal dam pa gzhan dag gis/ /brtson par mdzad na smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /bla ma mjal yang tshul bzhin ma bsten la/ /gdams ngag thos kyang nyams su ma lon zhing / /dben pa bsten kyang brtson 'grus ma nus pa'i/ /sdig ldan bdag gi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /las ngan mtsho chen rdol ba'i rmongs pa bdag /lha dang bcas pa'i snying rje'i yul yin mod/ /chos 'di'i bdud rtsi rna ba'i bu ga ru/ /son pa 'di tsam phyi ma'i lam rgyags yin/ /las nyon khur lci gshis ngan bdag 'dra yang / /thugs brtse'i thugs kyis rjes su bzung ba yi/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i tshe/ /mchi ma'i rgyun gyis 'dren byed brlan par byas/ /ma lus mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /nyams thag bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i bka' lung ji bzhin du/ /bsngags pa'i tshig 'di gus pa'i yid kyis sbyar/ /chos tshul 'di yi yon tan mtha' klas pa/ /chos med bdag gi spyod yul ma yin yang / /chos rje bla ma'i gsung gis yun ring du/ /bskyangs pa'i go yul phyogs tsam bshad pa lags/ /'di bgyis pa las byung ba'i dge ba kun/ /'di nyid go yul tsam du mi 'jog par/ /'di bzhin rang gis nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /'di don rgyud la 'byor pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /'jam mgon bla ma brgyud par bcas pa yi/
